notes: [P0] outcome: src/main.js never passes the selected kind to draw. Its diff (+2 -2) only edits two comments, and the draw call is unchanged. draw's new `kind` parameter therefore keeps its null default in the running game, so drawKind never runs and the HUD never names the selected kind. The brief requires 'main.js passes the selected kind to draw' and the issue requires 'the selected kind shows in the HUD'. The render test in test/frost.test.js calls draw with FROST directly, so it cannot catch this.

[P1] test coverage: the first three acceptance tests in test/frost.test.js apply the slow by calling slowEnemy directly. None of them puts a ghost through a real frost hit in step before measuring distance. The game-loop test checks that enemy.slow is set after a hit, but not the half-distance-in-the-next-second criterion end to end. A regression in how step applies tower.slow or tower.slowFor (for example, passing undefined slowFor) would still pass the distance tests.

[P2] scope: src/game.js adds a non-enumerable spawnTimer accessor on the game state just so tests can stop spawning. The brief did not ask for it, and it adds a second public way into spawner.timer that only affects the current wave's spawner.
